<!-- Generated by tools/gen/config-reference.mjs from packages/config-schema/shipkeep.schema.json. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen`. -->

Configuration of one Shipkeep application, stored as shipkeep.yml at the root of its repository (SPEC section 2). Unknown keys are errors. Secrets are referenced by name only.

The file is checked against its [JSON Schema](https://github.com/shipkeepdev/shipkeep/blob/main/packages/config-schema/shipkeep.schema.json) when it is saved, by the web UI, the CLI and the control plane. Durations are written like `30s`, `10m` or `1m30s`, and sizes like `512Mi` or `2Gi`.

A minimal application:

```yaml
version: 1
name: storefront
build:
  type: image
  image: nginx:1.27
run:
  port: 80
```

## `version`

**Type:** exactly `1`. **Required.**

Schema version. Only 1 exists.

## `name`

**Type:** string, matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`. **Required.**

Application name, unique inside its environment.

## `build`

**Type:** object.

### `build.type`

**Type:** one of `dockerfile`, `railpack`, `nixpacks`, `image`. **Required.**

How the image is produced.

> Only `image` works today. `dockerfile`, `railpack` and `nixpacks` describe builds, which are planned: the control plane refuses them.

### `build.context`

**Type:** string, at most 1024 characters.

Path relative to the repository root. No parent directory segments.

> For builds, which are planned.

### `build.dockerfile`

**Type:** string, at most 1024 characters.

Path relative to the repository root. No parent directory segments.

> For builds, which are planned.

### `build.args`

**Type:** map of names matching `^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$` to string, at most 100 entries.

Build arguments. Non-secret values only.

> For builds, which are planned.

### `build.image`

**Type:** string, matches `^[a-z0-9]+([._-][a-z0-9]+)*(:[0-9]+)?(/[a-z0-9]+([._-][a-z0-9]+)*)*(:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127})?(@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64})?$`, at most 512 characters.

Container image reference. Tags are resolved to digests by the control plane when it creates a release.

## `run`

**Type:** object.

### `run.command`

**Type:** list of string, at most 64 items.

Argv array. No shell is ever implied.

### `run.port`

**Type:** integer, from 1 to 65535. **Required.**

Port the application listens on inside the container.

### `run.healthcheck`

**Type:** object.

> Each replica is probed on `run.port` until it is healthy. A replica that is not healthy before the deadline (the start period plus 2 minutes, at most 30 minutes) fails the deployment, and the previous release keeps serving.

### `run.healthcheck.path`

**Type:** string, matches `^/`, at most 2048 characters. **Required.**

HTTP GET path; 2xx and 3xx are healthy.

### `run.healthcheck.interval`

**Type:** string, matches `^([0-9]+(ms|s|m|h))+$`, at most 32 characters. **Default:** `5s`.

Go-style duration, for example 30s, 10m, 72h or 1m30s.

### `run.healthcheck.timeout`

**Type:** string, matches `^([0-9]+(ms|s|m|h))+$`, at most 32 characters. **Default:** `2s`.

Go-style duration, for example 30s, 10m, 72h or 1m30s.

### `run.healthcheck.start_period`

**Type:** string, matches `^([0-9]+(ms|s|m|h))+$`, at most 32 characters. **Default:** `0s`.

Go-style duration, for example 30s, 10m, 72h or 1m30s.

### `run.healthcheck.healthy_threshold`

**Type:** integer, from 1 to 10. **Default:** `1`.

### `run.healthcheck.unhealthy_threshold`

**Type:** integer, from 1 to 10.

> Accepted, not applied yet.

### `run.read_only_root`

**Type:** boolean. **Default:** `false`.

Run the container with a read-only root filesystem and a 64Mi tmpfs at /tmp, so that it writes only there (counted in its memory) and to its volumes (ADR 0022). Off by default: many images write elsewhere.

## `release`

**Type:** object.

Command run once per release before traffic switches (migrations).

> Runs once per release, on the server of the first replica, before that replica starts. A non-zero exit fails the deployment. A rollback does not run it again.

### `release.command`

**Type:** list of string, at most 64 items. **Required.**

Argv array. No shell is ever implied.

### `release.timeout`

**Type:** string, matches `^([0-9]+(ms|s|m|h))+$`, at most 32 characters. **Default:** `10m`.

Go-style duration, for example 30s, 10m, 72h or 1m30s.

## `resources`

**Type:** object.

Limits of each container. cpu and memory are also what placement reserves on the node; disk bounds what the container writes to its own filesystem (its writable layer), measured by the agent, which stops a container above it (ADR 0022). A limit left out is 1 CPU, 512Mi of memory, or 1Gi of disk.

### `resources.cpu`

**Type:** string, matches `^([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?|[0-9]+m)$`, at most 16 characters. **Default:** `1`.

CPU limit in cores ("0.5") or millicores ("500m"), greater than zero.

### `resources.memory`

**Type:** string, matches `^[0-9]+(Ki|Mi|Gi|Ti|K|M|G|T)?$`, at most 32 characters. **Default:** `512Mi`.

Kubernetes-style size, for example 512Mi or 2Gi. A bare number is bytes. Zero is not a size.

### `resources.disk`

**Type:** string, matches `^[0-9]+(Ki|Mi|Gi|Ti|K|M|G|T)?$`, at most 32 characters. **Default:** `1Gi`.

Kubernetes-style size, for example 512Mi or 2Gi. A bare number is bytes. Zero is not a size.

## `scale`

**Type:** object.

### `scale.replicas`

**Type:** integer, from 1 to 100. **Default:** `1`.

### `scale.placement`

**Type:** object.

### `scale.placement.spread`

**Type:** one of `node`, `none`. **Default:** `node`.

### `scale.placement.labels`

**Type:** map of names matching `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9._-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$` to string, at most 50 entries.

Required node labels.

### `scale.placement.nodes`

**Type:** list of string, at most 100 items, no duplicates.

Explicit node names.

> Server names. A replica goes only to one of them.

## `domains`

**Type:** list of string, at most 50 items, no duplicates.

> Each domain gets a certificate once its DNS record points to a server that runs the application. Wildcards are refused until DNS-01 exists.

## `env`

**Type:** map of names matching `^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$` to string, at most 200 entries.

Non-secret environment variables.

## `secrets`

**Type:** list of string, at most 200 items, no duplicates.

Names of secrets injected as environment variables. Values live in the control plane.

> Set the values on the environment first: a deployment that names a secret with no value is refused before it starts.

## `volumes`

**Type:** list of object, at most 50 items.

> Refused for now: volumes are not mounted yet, so what an application wrote there would be lost at its next deployment. An empty list is accepted.

### `volumes[].name`

**Type:** string, matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`. **Required.**

Name of a volume, database or node.

### `volumes[].path`

**Type:** string, matches `^/`, at most 4096 characters. **Required.**

Absolute path inside the container. No parent directory segments; not under /proc, /sys, /dev, /etc or /var/run.

### `volumes[].backup`

**Type:** object.

### `volumes[].backup.schedule`

**Type:** string, matches `^\S+ \S+ \S+ \S+ \S+$`, at most 128 characters. **Required.**

Five-field cron expression.

### `volumes[].backup.keep`

**Type:** integer, from 1 to 365.

## `databases`

**Type:** list of object, at most 20 items.

> Refused for now: managed databases are planned. An empty list is accepted.

### `databases[].ref`

**Type:** string, matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`. **Required.**

Managed database in the same environment.

### `databases[].env`

**Type:** string, matches `^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$`, at most 256 characters. **Required.**

Secret name that receives the connection string.

## `previews`

**Type:** object.

> Refused for now, unless `enabled: false`: preview environments are planned.

### `previews.enabled`

**Type:** boolean.

### `previews.ttl`

**Type:** string, matches `^([0-9]+(ms|s|m|h))+$`, at most 32 characters.

Go-style duration, for example 30s, 10m, 72h or 1m30s.

### `previews.max_active`

**Type:** integer, from 0 to 50.

### `previews.database`

**Type:** one of `none`, `empty`, `clone`.

## `deploy`

**Type:** object.

### `deploy.strategy`

**Type:** one of `rolling`, `recreate`.

> Every deployment is `rolling`: the new replicas start, the traffic switches, then the previous ones stop. `recreate` is refused for now.

### `deploy.drain_timeout`

**Type:** string, matches `^([0-9]+(ms|s|m|h))+$`, at most 32 characters. **Default:** `30s`, at most `5m`.

Go-style duration, for example 30s, 10m, 72h or 1m30s.

### `deploy.keep_images`

**Type:** integer, from 1 to 50.

> Refused for now: servers do not remove old images yet.

## `compose`

**Type:** object.

> Compose applications are planned: the control plane refuses them for now.

### `compose.file`

**Type:** string, at most 1024 characters. **Required.**

Path relative to the repository root. No parent directory segments.

### `compose.expose`

**Type:** list of object, at most 50 items.

Services published through the edge proxy.

### `compose.expose[].service`

**Type:** string, matches `^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,62}$`. **Required.**

### `compose.expose[].port`

**Type:** integer, from 1 to 65535. **Required.**

### `compose.expose[].domains`

**Type:** list of string, at most 50 items, no duplicates.
